mapper.sql: coalesce( (select c.new_arrived from club_event_attendance_correction c where c.id = (select max(c2.id) from club_event_attendance_correction c2 where c2.activity_id = r.owner_id and c2.member_id = r.member_id)), case when exists (select 1 from club_lead_checkin ck where ck.activity_id = r.owner_id and ck.member_id = r.member_id) or exists (select 1 from cms_registration v where v.owner_type = 2 and v.owner_id = r.owner_id and v.member_id = r.member_id and v.payment_status = 2 and v.registration_status = 2 and v.verification_status = 1) or exists (select 1 from player_node_progress p where p.activity_id = r.owner_id and p.member_id = r.member_id and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = 0) then 1 else 0 end) = 1
mapper.select: select id, topic_id as topicId, activity_id as activityId, coop_order_id as coopOrderId, merchant_member_id as merchantMemberId, leader_member_id as leaderMemberId, verify_time as verifyTime from coop_group_verify where activity_id = #{activityId} order by id

select r.id as registrationId, r.order_num as orderNum, (select count(1) from cms_registration_seat s where s.registration_id = r.id and s.status = 1) as verifiedSeats from cms_registration r where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and and not exists ( select 1 from refund_application ra where ra.source_type = 'registration' and ra.source_id = r.id and ra.status = 1 and ra.del_flag = 0)
and r.id = #{registrationId}
and not exists ( select 1 from cms_activity_settlement_hold h where h.registration_id = r.id and h.activity_id = r.owner_id and h.status = 0)
order by r.id for update

select id, claim_id as claimId, merchant_id as merchantId, source_type as sourceType, source_id as sourceId, receiver_type as receiverType, receiver_id as receiverId, gross_amount as grossAmount, commission_amount as commissionAmount, settlement_amount as settlementAmount, status from settlement_detail where source_type = 'registration' and source_id = #{registrationId} and receiver_type = 'merchant' and status in (0, 1) order by id for update
mapper.update: update settlement_detail set gross_amount = gross_amount - #{fee}, settlement_amount = settlement_amount - #{fee}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0 and receiver_type = 'merchant' and settlement_amount >= #{fee} and gross_amount >= #{fee}
